important_points: President Donald Trump on Friday announced White House deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller will be promoted to chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles.

items.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC

items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar on Friday said the company will continue to invest in artificial intelligence infrastructure, even after voters strongly opposed data centers during Tuesday's midterm elections.；"When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet that customer demand," Friar told CNBC's Sara Eisen in an interview at the Citi TMT Leadership Summit in Pebble Beach, California.；"It starts early with having built relationships with all of the hyperscalers, and it will continue to mean that we raise capital."
